comment: He is so nice and chill and really tries to make the content interesting and interactive. Midterm and final and participation are only grades. Tests are all multiple choice and you get cheat sheets. Not hard, interesting stuff, and really great guy.
Great professor. Makes himself available outside of class. Absolute beast.

McMahan is phenomenal. Honestly, If I hadn't been told he wasn't a full-time prof, I'd never have been able to tell. He keeps things engaging by using examples from pop culture (ex: The Office), but also does a good job at actually teaching you about law. You can tell he loves what he does, and cares about doing well. Can't recommend him enough.
